transformation_description: Raw uncompressed streaming clickstream logs ingested into distributed HDFS cluster across 13 partitions.
known_caveats: Contains 68,673 zero/negative prices
Contains 13.5M unclassified categories and 6.1M unbranded products
Contains 30,217 unsegregated malformed records

transformation_description: Cleaned Parquet dataset generated via distributed PySpark filtering of non-positive prices and unsegregated anomalies.
known_caveats: Retains 99.767% of raw volume (98,890 rows removed)
Categories and brands coalesced to 'Unknown / Other' and 'Unknown'

transformation_description: PySpark group-by aggregation counting total occurrences of view (40,708,807), cart (898,294), and purchase (742,773) events.
known_caveats: Reflects raw event counts, not session-level or user-level conversion probabilities

transformation_description: Distributed hourly extraction from UTC timestamps summing all 42,349,874 cleaned events across hours 0 through 23.
known_caveats: All hours represent UTC timestamps; peak at 21:00 UTC corresponds to local evening peak in primary consumer timezones

transformation_description: Distributed aggregation filtering purchase events and summing gross revenue across 24 UTC hourly bins, totaling 229,933,212.63 units.
known_caveats: Reveals temporal decoupling: peak revenue occurs at 14:00 UTC whereas peak browsing activity occurs at 21:00 UTC

transformation_description: Distributed group-by on primary taxonomy prefix summing purchase events and transaction value across 14 top-level categories.
known_caveats: Electronics dominates platform GMV (166.4M units, 72.38% share)
Unclassified subcategories are grouped under 'Unknown / Other'

transformation_description: Full brand rollup across 1,985 named commercial brands plus 1 unbranded aggregation row, detailing purchases and total revenue.
known_caveats: Contains 1,985 named commercial brands + 1 unbranded event aggregation row = 1,986 records total
Top 10 brands account for 81.65% of recorded brand revenue

transformation_description: Aggregated daily purchase events and revenue for October 1 through November 1, 2019.
known_caveats: November 1 record represents a partial UTC logging day before dataset cutoff (8,065 purchases)

transformation_description: Aggregated purchase counts and revenues rolled up by day-of-week (Monday through Sunday).
known_caveats: October 2019 calendar includes 5 Tuesdays, 5 Wednesdays, and 5 Thursdays vs 4 for other weekdays

transformation_description: Binned user event counts across 5 activity brackets (1-5, 6-10, 11-20, 21-50, >50 events) covering all 3,021,435 distinct users.
known_caveats: 55.23% of all users fall in the 1-5 events bracket, exhibiting massive long-tail casual browsing

transformation_description: Categorization of purchase volume and gross revenue across 7 monetary price bands (0-50, 50-100, 100-250, 250-500, 500-1000, 1000-2000, >2000 units).
known_caveats: The 500-1000 unit bracket captures the largest single share of revenue (70.1M units, 30.5%) driven by smartphones

transformation_description: Top 10 individual product IDs ranked by gross purchase revenue in October 2019.
known_caveats: Top product generated 12,404,835.95 units across 12,541 purchases

transformation_description: Top 10 individual product IDs ranked by total units purchased.
known_caveats: Top product recorded 21,804 purchases generating 5,430,222.72 units

transformation_description: Synthesized 11 behavioral features per distinct user: total events, views, carts, purchases, revenue, sessions, catalog breadth.
known_caveats: Includes 1 extreme browsing outlier account (7,429 views, 0 purchases) quarantined in subsequent clustering

transformation_description: Eigen-decomposition of 11x11 correlation matrix into 7 principal components retaining 95.967% cumulative variance.
known_caveats: PC1 (40.71%) and PC2 (17.93%) capture 58.64% of variance; component meanings represent linear factor weights

transformation_description: K-Means model centroids in business units: Cluster 0 High-Activity Core (250,388 users) vs Cluster 1 Casual Browsers (2,771,046 users).
known_caveats: Selected from 6 sensitivity trials (Silhouette 0.81115); excludes 1 extreme browsing outlier (usr_***849)

transformation_description: Extracted from 26_category_brand_treemap.html into a clean 159-node hierarchical tree of categories and underlying commercial brands.
known_caveats: Captures top brand contributors within major retail categories

transformation_description: Extracted from 25_product_bubble_chart.html containing top 100 products with purchases, revenue, unique buyers, and average price.
known_caveats: Coordinates represent individual product metrics across October 2019
